      Allows the specified entity to enter this tile.
      Parameters:
      enteree - the entity to enter this tile
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tile may not be occupied by the entity
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the tile may never be occupied

    • put

      void put(Entity enteree)
      similar to enter(Entity) but does not execute any additional actions
      Parameters:
      enteree - the entity to put in this tiles
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the tile is already occupied
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the tile may never be occupied

    • getOccupant

      Optional<Entity> getOccupant()
      Returns the entity currently occupying this tile, if any.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the entity currently occupying this tile, or an empty Optional if the tile is empty

    • leave

      void leave(Entity exitee)
      Allows the specified entity to leave this tile.

      This method removes the entity from the tile if the entity was the occupant of this tile, indicating that the entity has moved to another tile in the game world. If the entity is not currently occupying this tile, this method does nothing.

      Parameters:
      exitee - the entity to leave this tile

    • compareTo

      default int compareTo(Tile other)
      Compares this tile with the specified tile for order.

      This method is used for sorting tiles in a game world. It compares the locations of the tiles, using the natural ordering of Point.

      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Tile>
      Parameters:
      other - the tile to be compared with this tile
      Returns:
      an integer representing the ordering of the tiles
      See Also:
      • Point.compareTo(Point)
